module_description: Real-world applications of humanoid robots, ethical considerations, emerging technologies, competition benchmarks, and practical getting-started guides

chapters.title: Real-World Applications
learning_objectives: Understand deployment requirements for industrial humanoid robots
Analyze case studies from manufacturing, healthcare, and research
Evaluate real-world constraints: cost, reliability, and scalability
Design system architectures for specific application domains
Plan transition from simulation to physical deployment
sections: Case Study: Boston Dynamics Atlas (2024 Update)
Case Study: Unitree H1 Humanoid (2024 Update)

chapters.title: Ethical Considerations
learning_objectives: Analyze ethical implications of humanoid robot deployment
Understand job displacement and economic impacts
Design human-centered robot systems with transparency
Address safety, privacy, and autonomy concerns
Develop ethical frameworks for robotics development

chapters.title: Emerging Technologies
learning_objectives: Survey cutting-edge humanoid robot technologies and trends
Understand advances in AI, sensors, and actuators
Analyze fusion of humanoid robots with IoT and cloud computing
Explore soft robotics and bio-inspired approaches
Predict future research directions and opportunities

chapters.title: Competition & Benchmarks
learning_objectives: Understand major robotics competitions and benchmarks (RoboCup, DARPA, etc.)
Analyze winning approaches and innovations from competitions
Evaluate performance metrics and standardized benchmarks
Compare state-of-the-art systems and technologies
Identify research opportunities from competition results

chapters.title: Getting Started: Your First Project
learning_objectives: Plan and scope a beginner-friendly robotics project
Set up development environment and required tools
Implement a simple humanoid robot control task
Debug and test code in simulation environment
Deploy solution and document results
